scene: A fixed forward-facing dashcam records a dry multilane highway in daylight, with white lane lines, a concrete median and hedges on the left, and a guardrail and trees on the right. Road users: the ego car, a silver minivan, and one helmeted rider on a red motorcycle.
captions: During the first half of this second, the helmeted rider on the red motorcycle closes the remaining gap from behind the ego car, travelling beside the silver minivan on the left. Around the middle of this second, the front wheel and red front fairing gradually enter through the lower-left edge of the dashcam image. The same light-helmeted rider in a dark jacket follows into view, seated naturally on the same red motorcycle. The motorcycle moves forward through the visible gap between the silver minivan and the ego car, with both wheels aligned with the road and a clear physical gap to the two larger vehicles. By the end of the second the rider and motorcycle are clearly visible alongside the front-left of the ego car. The ego car and silver minivan continue straight in their separate lanes, while lane markings, guardrail, hedges and trees move continuously past the fixed camera.

The same helmeted rider on the red motorcycle is clearly visible ahead-left of the ego car. The rider moves smoothly forward beyond the ego front bumper, opens a small visible safety gap, then follows a shallow rightward arc from the corridor into the highway lane immediately to the right of the silver minivan. The red motorcycle straightens in front of the ego car and continues accelerating along that lane. The rider retains the same light-coloured helmet and dark jacket; the red body, wheels and overall silhouette stay continuous throughout the manoeuvre. The silver minivan maintains its original left-hand lane and continues moving forward, remaining separate from the motorcycle. The ego car holds its lane and steady speed as the fixed dashcam sees a straight, connected roadway, flowing white markings, a guardrail on the right and unchanged bright daylight.

The helmeted rider on the same red motorcycle continues forward in the lane ahead of the ego car, to the right of the silver minivan. The motorcycle and rider remain clearly visible as a single persistent road user; the rider sits upright in the same dark jacket and light-coloured helmet. As the motorcycle increases its distance, its apparent size decreases gradually while its red body and two wheels retain their identity and proportions. The silver minivan continues in the adjacent left-hand lane without changing into the motorcycle lane. The ego car drives steadily forward within its original lane, following the rider from a growing distance. The fixed dashcam keeps its forward-facing viewpoint, with a continuous straight highway, stable white lane dividers, roadside hedges and trees, and the right-hand guardrail moving smoothly past under the same daylight.
